{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:", df.columns.tolist())
print("\nFirst few rows:\")
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print("\nCount of -1 in customer_age:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue dtype and sample values
print("\nRevenue dtype:", df['revenue'].dtype)
print("Sample revenue values:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for QA orders
print("\nCount of revenue == 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Check status
print("\nUnique values in status:", df['status'].unique())

# Check channel and customer_segment
print("\nUnique values in channel:", df['channel'].unique())
print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:", df['customer_segment'].unique())"}
